name: Xu-Ifit
description: A Monoist surgeon at Susur Secundi who experiments on acolytes in order to rescue her wife, frozen in the supervoid by time dilation.

description_citations.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
description_citations.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Xu-Ifit's wife is frozen by time dilation after plunging into the supervoid.
timeline.quote: Ten years ago, Xu-Ifit's wife made the plunge into the Sotheran supervoid but was caught in a sudden gravitational anomaly, leaving her frozen in place by time dilation.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Xu-Ifit experiments on Monoist acolytes to perfect a way to save her wife.
timeline.quote: she experiments on Monoist acolytes, testing their survivability through dangerous missions before sending them to take the plunge into the Sotheran supervoid.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.
